items.title: Jane Bunnett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 25, 2024
items.q: I look to somebody like Terri Lyne Carrington to answer those questions and I really admire her

ctx.x: And would it be better? Or doesn’t it matter?

Yeah, it probably would be better but you know just at the same — I don’t know. You know I look to somebody like Terri Lyne Carrington to answer those questions and I really admire her because she has been so honest and forthcoming about what she came up through. You know she was a brilliant, talented 10-year-old or however old she was when she, you know her family was like so totally behind her. And you know so many of the musicians took her under their wing which is just marvelous because she’s just like one of…

be Canadian, because I’m out of — I know you’re looking at me funny there. But yeah, because I’m not on the — that’s sort of changing a tiny bit now too but you know New York is very centric to hey we don’t know about you — yeah. We don’t know about you. I’m not on the New York scene. I’m in Toronto. I’m based here. I’m Canadian. I remember Paul Bley telling me to take it out of my bio, take it out, take the Canadian out.
